";const style=document.createElement('style');style.textContent='body.tavros-focus header,body.tavros-focus nav,body.tavros-focus .sidebar{display:none!important}body.tavros-focus main{max-width:100%!important;margin:0!important}';document.head.append(style);const exit=document.createElement('button');exit.textContent='Exit Focus';exit.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:999999;background:#9b5cff;color:white;padding:12px 18px;display:none';document.body.append(exit);const off=()=>{document.body.classList.remove('tavros-focus');exit.style.display='none';if(document.fullscreenElement)document.exitFullscreen().catch(()=>{})};root.querySelector('[data-on]').onclick=()=>{document.body.classList.add('tavros-focus');exit.style.display='block';document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.().catch(()=>{})};exit.onclick=off;return()=>{root.remove();off();style.remove();exit.remove();root.replaceChildren()};
